_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - neutral annual-fund wording that demonstrates the required shape without asserting program statistics, outcomes, benefits, matches, naming opportunities, or other unconfirmed facts. Generate a real file per campaign with: python scripts/render_letters.py asks_review.csv letters/ --emit-content content.json. Keys are donor segments from the review CSV's 'segment' column. Values are inserted into the letter as HTML, so inline markup works; never put donor-specific data in them (the renderer does not escape these blocks, and one block is shared by every donor in the segment). This file is not read automatically by either script.

campaign_paragraphs.Platinum: Your longstanding generosity is deeply appreciated. As the organization plans for the year ahead, a renewed annual gift would provide flexible support for its mission.
campaign_paragraphs.Gold: Your past generosity is sincerely appreciated. A renewed annual gift would help the organization continue pursuing its mission in the year ahead.
campaign_paragraphs.Silver: Thank you for the support you have given in the past. We hope you will consider renewing that support through this year's annual campaign.
campaign_paragraphs.Bronze: Every contribution is appreciated, and participation at any level matters. We hope you will consider taking part in this year's annual campaign.
campaign_paragraphs.Lapsed: It has been a little while since we last heard from you, and we remain grateful for your earlier support. You would be warmly welcomed back whenever the time is right.

tier_lines.Platinum: If you would like to discuss ways to deepen your support, I would welcome a conversation.
tier_lines.Gold: If you would like to explore longer-term ways to support the mission, our team would be glad to speak with you.
tier_lines.Silver: A gift at the level that is right for you would be gratefully received.
tier_lines.Bronze: Whatever amount feels right to you would be sincerely appreciated.
tier_lines.Lapsed: Whatever amount feels right is genuinely welcome; the important thing is simply to reconnect.
